name: EPAM Systems

logo.source: investors.epam.com site header logo (epam_logo_light.svg, black wordmark for light backgrounds); the only Wikimedia file found (EPAM logo.png, 288x108, 2015) is an old mark

description: EPAM is a software engineering and digital consulting firm that rents out engineers. Clients, mainly banks, retailers, software and media companies and drug makers, pay for teams of engineers, designers and consultants who build and run their software, data platforms, cloud migrations and AI systems. Most revenue is billed by the hour, day or month (time-and-materials), the rest on fixed-price contracts, so revenue follows the number of billable people and their utilization. About 56,600 of its 62,850 staff are delivery professionals, with the largest groups in India (about 12,200) and Ukraine (about 8,750), plus Poland, Belarus and Mexico. Revenue was $5.46 billion in 2025, up 15.4 percent, with 59 percent from clients in the Americas and 39 percent in Europe, the Middle East and Africa.

sub.name: IT and management consulting and back-office outsourcing

gics.note: Per Wikipedia 'List of S&P 600 companies' (raw wikitext read 2026-10-27). EPAM was moved from the S&P 500 to the S&P SmallCap 600 on June 2, 2026 as 'more representative of the small cap market space' (same page), so it is no longer in the S&P 500 list. That list gives only sector and sub-industry; industry group and industry are null.

hq.note: 41 University Drive, Suite 202, Newtown, Pennsylvania 18940 (FY2025 10-K Item 1)

employees.note: "approximately 62,850 employees", of which about 56,600 are delivery professionals (2024: 61,200 and 55,100). Utilization of delivery professionals 76.8% in 2025 (FY2025 10-K)

businessLines.name: Americas segment
businessLines.how: Engineering teams billed to clients by the hour, day or month under time-and-materials contracts (the majority), with some fixed-price projects and maintenance contracts recognized over the service period.
businessLines.description: Client relationships managed by the Americas management team; the segment's geographic footprint includes growing operations in Latin America.

businessLines.description: Client relationships managed by the Europe management team. APAC revenue of $108.8M (2.0% of total) is reported by client location, not as a segment.
